## Background

We ran 3 AlphaFold2 predictions,

- HIV-PR_Monomer
- HIV-PR_dimer
- My find-a-gene protein sequence

Here we analyze the resulting models and make some diagnostic plots that inform on model reliability

## 1. HIV-PR Monomer

```{r}
list.files(path= "HIV_monomer_94b5b_2/" ,
           full.names = F,
           pattern = ".pdb")
```

```{r}
pdb_files <- list.files(path= "HIV_monomer_94b5b_2/" ,
                        full.names = T,
                        pattern = ".pdb")
```

```{r}
library(bio3d)

pdbs <- pdbaln(pdb_files, fit=TRUE, exefile="msa")
```

```{r}
pdbs
```

## RMSD

Calculate the RMSD of all models to each other (i.e. pairwise RMSD)

```{r}
rd <- rmsd(pdbs, fit=T)
```

and a heatmap display

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

colnames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
rownames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
pheatmap(rd)
```

## RMSF

Calculate RMSF - how far apart each amino-acid is accross all 5 AlphaFold models

```{r}
rf <- rmsf(pdbs$xyz)
plot.bio3d(rf)
```

### Residue Conservation

```{r}
aln_file <- list.files(path="HIV_monomer_94b5b_2/",
                        pattern=".a3m$",
                        full.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
aln <- read.fasta(aln_file[1], to.upper = TRUE)
```

```{r}
dim(aln$ali)
```

```{r}
sim <- conserv(aln)
```

```{r}
plotb3(sim[1:99], sse=trim.pdbs(pdbs, chain="A"),
       ylab="Conservation Score")
```

```{r}
con <- consensus(aln, cutoff = 0.9)
con$seq
```

### pLDDT & PAE score plots

The pLDDT scores are stroed in the PDB models "B-factor" col and in a sepereate JSON format file in the results directory. We can use either:

```{r}
plotb3(pdbs$b[1,], typ="l", lwd=2, sse=pdbs)
points(pdbs$b[2,], typ="l", col="red")
points(pdbs$b[3,], typ="l", col="blue")
points(pdbs$b[4,], typ="l", col="darkgreen")
points(pdbs$b[5,], typ="l", col="orange")
abline(v=100, col="gray")
```

## 2. Hive-PR Dimer
```{r}
list.files(path="HIV_Dimer_23119/",

full.names = F,
pattern=".pdb")
```
```{r}
pdb_files <- list.files(path="HIV_Dimer_23119/",

full.names = T,
pattern="*.pdb")
# Print our PDB file names
basename(pdb_files)
```
```{r}
library(bio3d)
pdbs <- pdbaln(pdb_files, fit=TRUE, exefile="msa")
```
```{r}
pdbs
```

## RMSD
```{r}
rd <- rmsd(pdbs, fit=T)
```


```{r}
library(pheatmap)
colnames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
rownames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
pheatmap(rd)
```

## RMSF
```{r}
rf <- rmsf(pdbs$xyz)
plot.bio3d(rf)
```

### Residue Conservation
```{r}
aln_file <- list.files(path="HIV_Dimer_23119/",
pattern=".a3m$",
full.name=TRUE)

aln_file
```

```{r}
aln <- read.fasta(aln_file[1], to.upper=TRUE)
```

```{r}
sim <- conserv(aln)
```

```{r}
plot(sim, typ="h")
```

```{r}
con <- consensus(aln, cutoff=0.9)
con$seq
```
```{r}
m1.pdb <- read.pdb(pdb_files[1])
occ <- vec2resno(rep(sim[1:99], 2), m1.pdb$atom$resno)
write.pdb(m1.pdb, o=occ, file="m1_dimer_conserv.pdb")
```

### pLDDT & PAE score plots
```{r}
plotb3(pdbs$b[1,], typ="l", lwd=2, sse=m1.pdb)
```

```{r}
# Initialize the plot first using the first dataset range
plot(pdbs$b[2, ], type="l", col="red", ylim=c(min(pdbs$b, na.rm=TRUE), max(pdbs$b, na.rm=TRUE)))

# Then add the remaining lines
points(pdbs$b[3, ], type="l", col="blue")
points(pdbs$b[4, ], type="l", col="darkgreen")
points(pdbs$b[5, ], type="l", col="orange")
abline(v=99, col="gray")
```

### Residue Conservation

```{r}
aln_file <- list.files(path= "test_e1404",

pattern=".a3m$",
full.name=TRUE)

aln_file
```

```{r}
aln <- read.fasta(aln_file[1], to.upper=TRUE)
```

```{r}
sim <- conserv(aln)
```

```{r}
plot(sim, typ="h")
```

```{r}
con <- consensus(aln, cutoff=0.9)
con$seq
```

```{r}
m1.pdb <- read.pdb(pdb_files[1])
n_res <- length(unique(m1.pdb$atom$resno))
occ <- vec2resno(sim[1:n_res], m1.pdb$atom$resno)
write.pdb(m1.pdb, o=occ, file="m1_conserv.pdb")
```
